rapport_notes: Patient and clear through an unusual, split-household move (a day bed moved within the house, plus a few pieces to a father's house nearby).

evidence_quotes.agenda: "Do you have any special instructions, concerns or stressors about moving in general?" - asked after the full item list and both addresses were confirmed.

top_strength: Correctly untangled an unusual two-address, mixed within-house-and-to-relative move without confusion, keeping the profile accurate.
coaching_note: The estimate given was just the flat 2.5-hour minimum charge with no typical-time range or personalization tied to the specific items - worth still anchoring even on a small job so the customer understands what drives the price.
